Algebraic expressions: Combine like terms and use the distributive property a(b + c) = ab + ac. Evaluate by substituting the value of the variable.
Solving linear equations: Do the same operation to both sides to isolate the variable. Expand brackets first and check the answer by substitution.
Linear relations and slope: Slope = rise / run = (y₂ − y₁) / (x₂ − x₁). Parallel lines have equal slopes and perpendicular slopes are negative reciprocals.
Equations of lines and linear models: Write lines as y = mx + b, where m is the slope and b the y-intercept. A linear model has a fixed part plus a rate times the variable.
